dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Ten years ago today, we were shipwrecked on this island. We've been stranded here ever since."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Child, on this special day, Granny has a gift for you. It comes from Granny's hometown. Keep it safe, don't lose it. And don't forget the nursery rhyme Granny taught you."
